annotations.description: Superior Spider-Man copies a creature card from a graveyard. Quantum Riddler is a 4/6 flyer that draws a card on ETB (and has the bonus draw ability with low hand size), making it a far superior copy target. Sunpearl Kirin is a 2/1 flyer whose ETB bounces one of your own nonland permanents — which is actively bad here since GPT52 Hype has no tokens or permanents worth bouncing. The Spider-Man becomes a 4/4 regardless, but copying Quantum Riddler gives flying + card draw + potential future card advantage, while copying Sunpearl Kirin gives flying + a mostly useless/detrimental bounce ability.
annotations.actionTaken: Copied Sunpearl Kirin with Superior Spider-Man, getting a 4/4 flyer with a bounce-your-own-permanent ETB trigger.
annotations.betterLine: Copy Quantum Riddler to get a 4/4 flyer that draws a card on ETB and has the bonus draw ability when at one or fewer cards in hand, providing significantly more value.

annotations.description: Cast Nowhere to Run with no opposing creatures on the battlefield, completely wasting its -3/-3 ETB removal effect. Additionally, a land should have been played first before casting spells.
